newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Jeewon Ind plans 4-for-10 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Jeewon Ind plans 4-for-10 rights issue.

text.p: South Korea's Jeewon Industrial Co said on Friday it plans to offer a 4-for-10 rights issue in June at a 30 percent discount on the base issue price, which will be announced later.
The issue would raise Jeewon's paid-in capital to 21.83 billion won from the current 14.55 billion won, a company statement said.
Jeewon will issue 1.46 million new common shares and allocate 20 percent to its employees. The remainder will be offered for rights to its shareholders registered as of April 29.
Subscription for both employees and shareholders is set for June 2 and 3, with payment set by June 16.
Jeewon shares fell 3,700 won to close at their daily limit of 43,300 won on Friday.
